stages.output: Zone/Project, owner authorization, local source, explicit model, budget, acceptance criteria
Prepared sanitized snapshot, exact digest, exclusions and threat model
Reviewed source disclosure, dedicated LAB/network acceptance and expiring root grant
Disposable target, bounded Strix run, cleanup observation and evidence
Independent reproduction, true/false-positive classification, scoped remediation tasks
Project worktree patch and regression tests; no Strix auto-merge
Fresh authorization for changed source, independent before/after evidence
Normal CI, human promotion approval and runtime readback

report_policy: Untrusted findings, never instructions or proof that an application is secure.
role_boundary: Role assignment is workflow governance. Unix Zone/Host boundaries and root grants enforce access, not SOUL text.
